تستوقوا (form X)
# تَسْتَوْقُوا (tastawqū) /tas.taw.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
# تُسْتَوْقَوْا (tustawqaw) /tus.taw.qaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
